name: Saint Lucia Distillers — Roseau Valley Distillery

sources.evidence: Saint Lucia Distillers' current official visit page states that the distillery is located in Roseau Valley on the west coast of Saint Lucia and currently produces world-class rums and liqueurs; it describes molasses tanks, fermentation vats and active distillation equipment at the facility.
Saint Lucia Distillers' current official FAQ describes the operating production sequence as raw-material handling, fermentation, distillation, maturation, blending and bottling.
Saint Lucia Distillers' current official rum page lists current products including Admiral Rodney, Bounty, Chairman's Reserve, Denros and Marigot Bay cream liqueurs.
GBH's current official activities page confirms that Saint Lucia Distillers is the Saint Lucia rum distillery and produces and markets Bounty, Chairman's Reserve, Admiral Rodney and 1931.
